_curation.note: Hand-curated. `id` is the bare model id the Codex CLI accepts (model_selection = provider/id, under the openai family). Pricing and context_window are sourced from the OpenAI model pages and the litellm registry used for run-cost calculation. Ratings are relative 1-5, higher is better; `cost` is cost-efficiency (5 = cheapest). Maintained via the sync-model-catalog skill.
_curation.sources: Live Codex app-server session model list (spike/findings.md); the model list bundled in Codex CLI 0.159.3 (codex-acp 2.1.1) and served by the ChatGPT backend to it, checked 2026-10-01; developers.openai.com/api/docs/models; OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna launch (2026-09-22); OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol DevDay launch (2026-09-29); litellm model registry (models.litellm.ai), checked 2026-09-07
